claim: Baiersbronn holds eight Michelin stars in total across its restaurants, making it a per-capita Michelin star capital.
quote: Baiersbronn boasts a collective eight Michelin stars (one two-star and two three-star restaurants).

claim: Baiersbronn is a 9-Ortsteil municipality extending ~20 km along the Murg valley, with hotels in different side valleys.
quote: Baiersbronn includes the village districts of Friedrichstal, Mitteltal, Obertal, Tonbach, Klosterreichenbach, Röt-Schönegründ, Huzenbach, Schwarzenberg, and Schönmünzach, extending over 20 km in the Murg valley.

claim: Schwarzwaldstube at Hotel Traube Tonbach holds three Michelin stars (held continuously since 1992 under head chef Torsten Michel).
quote: 3-star restaurant Schwarzwaldstube ... continuously held three Michelin stars since 1992.

claim: Restaurant 1789 at Hotel Traube Tonbach holds one Michelin star under head chef Florian Stolte; it was formerly the Köhlerstube.
quote: The 1789 restaurant holds one Michelin star ... Chef Florian Stolte showcases his minimalist and modern approach.

claim: Hotel Bareiss in Mitteltal hosts the 3-Michelin-star Restaurant Bareiss under chef Claus-Peter Lumpp; à-la-carte rooms Kaminstube and Dorfstuben are also at the hotel but not separately starred.
quote: The 3-Star Restaurant Bareiss ... under chef Claus-Peter Lumpp. The Kaminstube ... The Dorfstuben specialises in traditional Swabian and Black Forest specialities.

claim: Schlossberg at Hotel Sackmann (Schwarzenberg) holds one Michelin star and operates Wednesday–Sunday evenings.
quote: Awards Received: 1 Michelin star. ... The restaurant operates Wednesday through Sunday from 18:00 to 24:00.

claim: Hotel Bareiss offers complimentary car service to Traube Tonbach (and vice versa) so guests can dine at both 3-star restaurants in one stay.
quote: Hotel Bareiss offers car service to Traube Tonbach, which is a couple miles away and has the other 3-star restaurant, with the same service available in return.

claim: Hotel Traube Tonbach sits ~3 mi (~5 km) from Baiersbronn station, with hotel-arranged taxi or limousine transfers.
quote: Hotel Traube Tonbach is 3 miles from the Baiersbronn Train Station.

claim: Hotel Bareiss is about 1.78 miles (~2.9 km) from Hotel Traube Tonbach by road, in different side valleys.
quote: Hotel Bareiss is 1.78 miles from Hotel Traube Tonbach.

claim: Hotel Sackmann is in Baiersbronn-Schwarzenberg, ~6.2 mi (~10 km) from central Baiersbronn up the Murg valley, with the next rail station ~0.3 km away.
quote: Baiersbronn city center is 6.2 miles from the hotel ... Schwarzenberg is 0.19 miles from the hotel.

claim: Schwarzwaldstube was ranked #1 in the world by La Liste 2026 under head chef Torsten Michel.
quote: Schwarzwaldstube erneut auf Platz 1 bei La Liste 2026.

claim: After the January 2020 fire and 2022 rebuild, the former Köhlerstube was renamed 1789 (the founding year of Traube Tonbach); both Schwarzwaldstube and 1789 regained their Michelin stars.
quote: Comeback mit 4 Sternen: Schwarzwaldstube und Köhlerstube ausgezeichnet ... Köhlerstube became 1789, in reference to the founding year of Traube Tonbach.

claim: Hotel Waldlust Tonbach is a 3-star Superior hotel at Tonbachstr. 174, on the same Tonbach valley road as Traube Tonbach.
Pension Wiesental is a budget guesthouse at Tonbachstr. 155, in the Tonbach valley near Hotel Traube Tonbach.
quote: Pension Wiesental is located at Tonbachstraße 155, 72270 Baiersbronn ... Nice and cheap guesthouse with a great view.

claim: Hotel Lamm Mitteltal is a 4-star wellness hotel at Ellbachstr. 4 in Mitteltal, ~400 m from Hotel Bareiss.
quote: Hotel Lamm ... nestled in the picturesque village of Mitteltal ... 4-star hotel ... about 400 metres away from Bareiss.

claim: Hotel Engel Obertal is a 5-star Superior wellness resort in Obertal but has no Michelin-starred restaurant on-site.
quote: Engel Obertal is a gourmet hotel and wellness resort ... 5-star superior wellness & pleasure resort ... located in the northern Black Forest.

claim: Schwarzwaldstube has held three Michelin stars continuously since 1993, the longest such streak in Germany; reservations fill out weeks ahead.
quote: Since 1993, the restaurant has maintained its three-star Michelin rating, the longest streak for any restaurant in Germany.
